test-code.description: a multi-statement block body is reported
a single-statement block body is reported: it converts mechanically to an expression
a block body returning a value is reported
an expression body is not reported
a method reference is not reported: it has no body at all
an expression lambda closing over a local is not reported
a bare delegation is left to PMD's LambdaCanBeMethodReference
an empty block body is not reported: there is nothing to extract
an empty block body with explicit parameters is not reported
a block containing only a comment is not reported: a comment is not a statement
a branching expression body is not reported: expression bodies are out of scope
a long chain in an expression body is not reported
a nested block lambda is reported
suppression is available at the site
several block lambdas in one method are each reported
the rule is skipped below Java 8, where lambdas do not exist
